noter: Removed the false urgency in CS's Swedish headline ("– IDAG"/today): $199 is the store's standing price, not a countdown, so the English headline states the real, verifiable discount ("20% OFF ROOF COVER") with no time pressure — also corrected the Swedish's 23% to the true 20% (save $50 off $249). kr → $ throughout (1469→$249, 1129→$199). 14 dagars ångerrätt (EU right-of-withdrawal) has no US equivalent, so every terms line became the 90-day guarantee instead. GT's headline was rewritten from a literal "perfect gift for the RV lover" (generic — any gift ad can say that, and it isn't falsifiable) to the campaign's own proven line, "He talks about his RV like it's a family member" — a specific, checkable behavior, matching adcopy-US-video.json's GT hook. PD's headline was grounded in the specific detail "roof seams" (used in the video ad copy's PD angle) instead of a generic "protect the roof" claim, so it can't be signed by a competitor's roof cover ad. SP's quote is Johan's real review, translated faithfully and re-broken into 2 lines (line lengths run a bit past the ±20% box target because the quote itself can't be shortened).
